item.title: Drug Free Cherokee Meeting Set for March 12
item.description: The Partnership for a Drug-Free Cherokee will meet on Thursday, March 12, at noon in the meeting room at Pop’s Smorgasbord restaurant, located at 1490 West Main Street in Centre. The meeting is open to anyone concerned about the community’s drug problem. Agenda items will include whether to dissolve the organization.
